# @surfaces-ui/agent-anthropic

An AgentBackend over Claude through the Anthropic SDK, for Surfaces UI chat.

An `AgentBackend` over Claude through the official Anthropic SDK, which you install alongside it.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/agent-anthropic @anthropic-ai/sdk
```

`@anthropic-ai/sdk` is a peer dependency: your app provides it.

## Use

```tsx
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { anthropicAgent } from "@surfaces-ui/agent-anthropic";

const agent = anthropicAgent({ client: new Anthropic(), system: "You help people explore their data." });
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
